description:
[h1]Minimalist Cards[/h1]

Clean clock, date and now-playing cards over a background that moves with your music. Everything can be turned on, off and recolored, and every option in the settings has a short explanation.

[h2]🕒 Clock & 📅 Date[/h2]
[list]
[*]12H or 24H format, with optional seconds
[*]Weekday and date in your system language
[*]Your own fonts, weights, colors and corner roundness for each card
[/list]

[h2]🎵 Now Playing[/h2]
[list]
[*]Album cover, song title and artist from your music player
[*]Long titles scroll smoothly
[*]Audio bars with peak dots, and three blocks that pulse with the bass, mids and treble
[*]Progress bar with elapsed and total time
[*]Hides itself when no music is playing, and optionally when it is paused
[/list]

[h2]🖼️ Background[/h2]
A stack of layers you can mix with their opacity sliders:
[list]
[*][b]Color[/b]: your own color, or one taken from the album cover
[*][b]Album Spin[/b]: the blurred cover of the song, slowly spinning and pulsing with the bass
[*][b]Triangles[/b]: a grid where random triangles light up on each beat, with adjustable rows, color, glow, fade and which sounds they react to
[*][b]Image[/b]: your own image (stretch, fill, fit, center or tile) or the album cover on the left, right or center
[/list]

[h2]🎨 Colors[/h2]
[list]
[*]Each card, the background and the triangles have your own color, replaced by the album color you choose while music plays
[*]"Keep my color" to never let the album change it, "Keep last color" to keep it after the music stops
[*]Text color: automatic (always readable), your own color, or an album color
[*]Optionally go back to your colors while the music is paused
[/list]

[h2]🔊 Audio[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Auto volume[/b]: bars and effects react as if the music were at full volume, even when it is quiet
[/list]

[h2]⚡ Lightweight[/h2]
[list]
[*]Bars and triangles are drawn on the GPU in a single pass, the blur is computed once per cover, and anything you turn off costs nothing
[/list]

[h2]💡 Tips[/h2]
[list]
[*]The music info comes from Wallpaper Engine's media integration: make sure it is enabled in Wallpaper Engine's settings and that your player supports it
[*]If something looks wrong after an update, press [b]Reset[/b] in the wallpaper settings
[*]Something not showing up? Turn on [b]Troubleshooting → Show debug info[/b] and include a screenshot of it when reporting
[/list]

[url=https://github.com/Onutirachi/minimalistCards/tree/main]GitHub[/url]

audiobarspeakdotsborderradius.condition: trackcardshow.value == true && trackcardshowbars.value == true && audiobarsshowpeakdots.value == true

audiobarspeakdotsgap.condition: trackcardshow.value == true && trackcardshowbars.value == true && audiobarsshowpeakdots.value == true

audiobarspeakdotsopacity.condition: trackcardshow.value == true && trackcardshowbars.value == true && audiobarsshowpeakdots.value == true

audiobarspeakdotssize.condition: trackcardshow.value == true && trackcardshowbars.value == true && audiobarsshowpeakdots.value == true

hintalbumspinbeatsensitivity.text:
How much the cover grows with the bass. 0 = off.
Default value = 0.2

hintalbumspinhideonpause.text:
Removes the spinning cover while the music is paused, even with “Keep last cover”.
Default value = Off

hintalbumspinkeepcover.text:
Keeps spinning the last cover when no music is playing. Off = the cover fades out.
Default value = Off

hintalbumspinopacity.text:
Lower = more of the background color shows through.
Default value = 1

hintalbumspinshow.text:
Turn off to hide the spinning cover.
Default value = On

hintaudioautovolume.text:
Bars and effects react as if the music were at full volume, even when it is quiet. Quiet parts of a song can then look as strong as loud ones.
Default value = On

hintaudiobarsborderradius.text:
0 = square corners, higher = rounder.
Default value = 60

hintaudiobarsgap.text:
0 = bars touch each other.
Default value = 4

hintaudiobarspeakdotsborderradius.condition: trackcardshow.value == true && trackcardshowbars.value == true && audiobarsshowpeakdots.value == true
hintaudiobarspeakdotsborderradius.text:
0 = square corners, higher = rounder.
Default value = 80

hintaudiobarspeakdotsgap.condition: trackcardshow.value == true && trackcardshowbars.value == true && audiobarsshowpeakdots.value == true
hintaudiobarspeakdotsgap.text:
Distance between the dot and the top of its bar.
Default value = 4

hintaudiobarspeakdotsopacity.condition: trackcardshow.value == true && trackcardshowbars.value == true && audiobarsshowpeakdots.value == true

hintaudiobarspeakdotssize.condition: trackcardshow.value == true && trackcardshowbars.value == true && audiobarsshowpeakdots.value == true

hintaudiobarsshowpeakdots.text:
Small dots that mark the highest point of each bar and fall slowly.
Default value = On

hintbackgroundcolor.text:
Your color for the solid color at the very bottom. While music plays, the album color replaces it, unless “Keep my color” is on.
Default value = black

hintbackgroundcoloralbum.text:
Which color of the album cover replaces your color while music plays.
Default value = Main color

hintbackgroundcolorkeep.text:
The album never changes the solid color at the very bottom.
Default value = Off

hintbackgroundimage.text:
The image file to show.
Default value = none

hintbackgroundimagebeatsensitivity.text:
How much the image grows with the bass. 0 = off.
Default value = 0

hintbackgroundimagecoverposition.text:
Left and Right fade out towards the center, like the cover in the music card. Center fades a little on both sides.
Default value = Left

hintbackgroundimagefit.text:
Stretch = fills the screen, may distort. Fill = fills without distorting, cuts the edges. Fit = shows the whole image. Center = original size. Tile = repeats the image.
Default value = Stretch

hintbackgroundimagehideonpause.text:
Removes the cover while the music is paused, even with “Keep last cover”.
Default value = Off

hintbackgroundimagekeepcover.text:
Keeps showing the last cover when no music is playing. Off = the cover fades out.
Default value = Off

hintbackgroundimageopacity.text:
Lower = more of the layers below show through.
Default value = 0.15

hintbackgroundimagesource.text:
Top layer: an image of your own, or the cover of the song playing.
Default value = Album cover

hintcardshorizontalposition.text:
0 = left edge, 50 = center, 100 = right edge.
Default value = 50

hintclockcardcolor.text:
Your color for this card. While music plays, the album color replaces it, unless “Keep my color” is on.
Default value = dark gray (#111111)

hintclockcardcoloralbum.text:
Which color of the album cover replaces your color while music plays.
Default value = Main color

hintclockcardcolorkeep.text:
The album never changes this card.
Default value = Off

hintclockcardcolorkeeplast.text:
After the music stops, keeps the last album colors instead of going back to yours.
Default value = Off

hintclockcardfontfamily.text:
Font of the time.
Default value = Unageo

hintclockcardformat12h.text:
Shows AM / PM instead of 0–23 h.
Default value = Off

hintclockcardshow.text:
Turn off to hide the clock card.
Default value = On

hintclockcardshowseconds.text:
Adds the seconds to the time.
Default value = On

hintclockcardtextalbum.text:
Which color of the album cover the text uses while music plays.
Default value = Text color

hintclockcardtextcolor.text:
Used when the text color is “My color”.
Default value = white

hintclockcardtextmode.text:
Automatic = black or white, whichever reads best. My color = your own color. Album color = a color of the album cover (automatic without music).
Default value = Album color

hintdatecardcolor.text:
Your color for this card. While music plays, the album color replaces it, unless “Keep my color” is on.
Default value = dark gray (#111111)

hintdatecardcoloralbum.text:
Which color of the album cover replaces your color while music plays.
Default value = Main color

hintdatecardcolorkeep.text:
The album never changes this card.
Default value = Off

hintdatecardcolorkeeplast.text:
After the music stops, keeps the last album colors instead of going back to yours.
Default value = Off

hintdatecardfulldatefontfamily.text:
Font of the day, month and year.
Default value = Unageo

hintdatecardshow.text:
Turn off to hide the date card.
Default value = On

hintdatecardtextalbum.text:
Which color of the album cover the text uses while music plays.
Default value = Text color

hintdatecardtextcolor.text:
Used when the text color is “My color”.
Default value = white

hintdatecardtextmode.text:
Automatic = black or white, whichever reads best. My color = your own color. Album color = a color of the album cover (automatic without music).
Default value = Album color

hintdatecardweekdayfontfamily.text:
Font of the day of the week.
Default value = Unageo

hintdebugshow.text:
Shows what Wallpaper Engine sends to the wallpaper: song, cover, playback and a log of events. Take a screenshot of it when reporting a problem.
Default value = Off

hintplaybackmycolorswhenpaused.text:
While the music is paused, every card and the background go back to your own colors.
Default value = Off

hinttrackcardartitsfontfamily.text:
Font of the artist name.
Default value = Unageo

hinttrackcardcolor.text:
Your color for this card. While music plays, the album color replaces it, unless “Keep my color” is on.
Default value = dark gray (#111111)

hinttrackcardcoloralbum.text:
Which color of the album cover replaces your color while music plays.
Default value = Main color

hinttrackcardcolorkeep.text:
The album never changes this card.
Default value = Off

hinttrackcardhideonpause.text:
Closes this card while the music is paused.
Default value = Off

hinttrackcardshow.text:
Turn off to hide the music card.
Default value = On

hinttrackcardshowbars.text:
Bars that dance with the music.
Default value = On

hinttrackcardshowbeats.text:
Three blocks that pulse with the bass, mids and treble.
Default value = On

hinttrackcardshowtimeline.text:
Elapsed and total time of the song.
Default value = On

hinttrackcardtextalbum.text:
Which color of the album cover the text uses while music plays.
Default value = Text color

hinttrackcardtextcolor.text:
Used when the text color is “My color”.
Default value = white

hinttrackcardtextmode.text:
Automatic = black or white, whichever reads best. My color = your own color. Album color = a color of the album cover (automatic without music).
Default value = Album color

hinttrackcardtitlefontfamily.text:
Font of the song name.
Default value = Unageo

hinttrianglesbeatsensitivity.text:
How many light up on each beat.
Default value = 0.35

hinttrianglesbeatthreshold.text:
Higher = only strong beats light triangles.
Default value = 1.3

hinttrianglescolor.text:
Your color for the triangles. While music plays, the album color replaces it, unless “Keep my color” is on.
Default value = dark gray (#111111)

hinttrianglescoloralbum.text:
Which color of the album cover replaces your color while music plays.
Default value = Main color

hinttrianglescolorkeep.text:
The album never changes the triangles.
Default value = Off

hinttrianglesfadeinduration.text:
How long they take to light up.
Default value = 0.1

hinttrianglesfadeoutduration.text:
How long they take to go dark.
Default value = 1.5

hinttrianglesglowstrength.text:
How bright they get. Above 1 they turn white.
Default value = 0.2

hinttrianglesopacity.text:
Lower = more of the layers below show through.
Default value = 0.33

hinttrianglesshow.text:
Turn off to hide the triangles.
Default value = On

hinttrianglesvariation.text:
Shade difference between triangles. 0 = all the same.
Default value = 0.2

information.text: 💡 If something looks wrong after an update, press Reset in the wallpaper settings.

labelalbumspin.text: <small>The cover of the song playing, blurred and slowly spinning behind the cards. Its color follows each song.</small>

labelaudiobars.text: <small>The bars inside the now playing card.</small>

labelaudioplayback.text: <small>How the wallpaper reacts to the music for every section.</small>

labelbackground.text: The background is made of layers, from bottom to top: color → Album Spin → Triangles → image. This section has the bottom and the top layers; Album Spin and Triangles have their own sections. Use the opacity sliders to mix them.

labelcards.text: <small>Size and position of all the cards together.</small>

labeldate.text: <small>The card with the weekday and the date, in your system language.</small>

labelintro.text:
Minimalist Cards

Clock, date and music cards over a background that moves with your music.

labeltip.text: 🎨 The background is made of layers: color, Album Spin, Triangles and image. Use their opacity sliders to blend them together. To remove an effect, turn it off or set its opacity to 0.

labeltrack.text: <small>The song playing on your PC, with cover, title and artist. Hides itself when nothing is playing.</small>

labeltriangles.text: <small>A grid of triangles in one color. On each beat of the music, a few random triangles light up and fade away.</small>

labeltroubleshooting.text: <small>Tools to find out what is wrong when something does not show up.</small>

title: Minimalist Cards
